name: paypal-sdk
description: Install and consume the PayPal Server SDK for .NET, grounded in a bundled SDK map. The integrate-paypal workflow skill plans a map-grounded contract sheet before any code is written, implements from it, and fixes SDK compile/build errors map-first — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the paypal-getting-started map skill and seven dotnet-* companion skills. No MCP server.
